senses.zh_definition: 专名的一种可核实用法：拉达，印度教中与克里希纳密切相关、体现神圣之爱的女神；输入词项是否指她，尚不能确定。
senses.en_definition: An attested proper-name reading: Radha, a Hindu goddess associated with Krishna and divine love; the packet's intended referent remains unconfirmed.
senses.ms_definition: Sebagai nama khas, Radha merujuk kepada dewi dalam agama Hindu yang dikaitkan dengan Krishna dan cinta ketuhanan; rujukan yang dimaksudkan dalam paket belum dapat dipastikan.
senses.nuances: 此处提供可核实的专名解释，不宣称它是已获 DBP 确认的马来语普通词条；马来语释义为编写释义。不能擅自改成 reda、redha 或其他近形词。以下搭配和例句展示该专名用法，不代表已验证的高频搭配。专名解释参见 [Smithsonian National Museum of Asian Art](https://asia.si.edu/whats-on/exhibitions/wisdom-of-the-goddess/)。

dual_scenarios.ms: Pameran ini menampilkan gambaran Radha dalam tradisi seni Hindu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 本展览呈现印度教艺术传统中的拉达形象。
dual_scenarios.en: This exhibition presents depictions of Radha in Hindu artistic traditions.

tu 对应 itu；专名 Radha 仍须大写。

messages.speaker: Mei Ling (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku nak tengok lukisan Radha kat galeri tu. Kau nak ikut?
messages.ms_standard: Saya hendak melihat lukisan Radha di galeri itu. Adakah awak hendak ikut?
messages.zh: 我想去那家画廊看看拉达的画，你要一起吗？
messages.en: I want to see the painting of Radha at that gallery. Want to come?

messages.speaker: Kavitha (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Nak! Kita pergi petang je, ya?
messages.ms_standard: Ya, saya hendak ikut. Kita pergi pada waktu petang sahaja, boleh?
messages.zh: 要！我们下午去就好，可以吗？
messages.en: Yes! Let's just go in the afternoon, okay?

etymology.historical_story: The name Radha has a documented history in Hindu devotional culture. The twelfth-century Gita Govinda gives her a central place as Krishna's beloved, and later paintings repeatedly explore their relationship. This cultural history supports a proper-name interpretation, but it does not establish what the unidentified lowercase token in the supplied packet originally referred to. See [Smithsonian National Museum of Asian Art](https://asia.si.edu/whats-on/exhibitions/wisdom-of-the-goddess/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 若此处指女神，把 Radha 与 Krishna 成对记忆；这个联想用于辨认专名，不用于推定读音或解释其他近形词。
